test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A, B and C can do a piece of work in 2, 12 and 6 days, respectively. How long (in days) will they take to do thrice the same work, working together?
solution:
**Given:**

A = 2 days

B = 12 days

C = 6 days

Total Work = 3 units

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = LCM of 2, 12, 6

Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time

Time = Total Work ÷ Total Efficiency
